summary: Admin panel billing application with barcode scanning for product entry
architectural_notes: Barcode scanning library: QuaggaJS, ZXing, or Html5-QRCode for EAN-13/UPC support
Camera API with auto-focus and torch/flash control
Database schema includes product barcode, name, price, and GST fields
known_issues: Current barcode scanner opens camera but fails to recognize/scan barcodes

existing_features.title: Integrate a high-speed barcode scanning library (QuaggaJS, ZXing, or Html5-QRCode) into the admin billing page to reliably recognize standard retail barcodes including EAN-13 and UPC formats
Enable auto-focus for the camera and add a Flash/Torch toggle button within the scanner UI to support scanning in low-light conditions

Implement instant product fetch: when a barcode is successfully scanned, automatically fetch the product name, price, and GST details from the database and add it to the billing list without requiring any manual clicks
Enable continuous scanning mode that allows the admin to scan multiple items one after another without closing the camera after each scan
Add a beep sound notification that plays when a barcode is successfully scanned to provide audio feedback to the admin
Implement error handling that shows a quick popup with the message 'Product Not Found - Add Manually?' when a scanned barcode is not found in the database
Update camera permission request description to: 'This app requires camera access for the Admin Billing Panel to scan product barcodes, ensuring fast and error-free billing for customers'

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix barcode scanner with high-speed library (QuaggaJS/ZXing/Html5-QRCode) for EAN-13/UPC
Add auto-focus and flash/torch toggle to scanner UI
Auto-fetch product name, price, GST from database after scan
Enable continuous scanning mode without closing camera
Add beep sound notification on successful scan
Show 'Product Not Found - Add Manually?' popup for missing barcodes
Update camera permission description for app store compliance

projectName: Fix barcode scanner in admin billing with high-speed library and professional features
